_comment: The workspace root. It must NOT share a name with packages/cli, which is the published `arterm-cli`: two packages answering to one name make `pnpm --filter arterm-cli <script>` ambiguous, and it resolved to THIS file — so `--filter arterm-cli test` silently ran `pnpm -r test` over the whole repo instead of the CLI's own suite.
name: arterm-workspace
description: Local AI coding agent for your terminal — hybrid Ollama + direct GGUF
